_doc: The slot of OpenBeam, the open source 15 x 15 mm beam: made to capture a plain M3 nut, so no special T-nut is needed ("Each of the 4 slots are designed to capture a regular DIN934 M3 nut"), and to take a 1/8 in (3 mm) sheet in its mouth. 3.2 mm between the lips, a pocket 5.8 mm wide to 3.7 mm from the face, then a floor that slants down to a groove 1.65 mm wide at 5.15 mm. Figures are from OpenBeam's dimensioned section as MakerBeam B.V. publishes it; the lip's thickness and the slant are worked out from its dimensions. OpenBeam publishes its designs under a Creative Commons licence: dimensions are taken, and the kit draws the slot from them. The drawn slot leaves out the rounds (R0.50 at the lips).
name: slot-3-openbeam

opening.rule: Between the lips: 3.200 [0.126 in] on the drawing. "The slots are also the correct width to fit a sheet of 1/8 in wood or acrylic"
opening.source: MakerBeam B.V., "overview specifications MB, MBXL, OB with pictures" (20161130), in MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawings folder, https://www.makerbeam.com/technical-drawings/

lip_thickness.rule: From the face to the underside of the lip: the drawing's chain of 5.153, 4.69 and 3.75 across the 15 leaves 1.407 for it
lip_thickness.source: MakerBeam B.V., "overview specifications MB, MBXL, OB with pictures" (20161130), in MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawings folder, https://www.makerbeam.com/technical-drawings/

cavity_width.rule: Width under the lips: 5.80 [0.228 in] on the drawing, for an M3 nut's 5.5 across flats
cavity_width.source: MakerBeam B.V., "overview specifications MB, MBXL, OB with pictures" (20161130), in MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawings folder, https://www.makerbeam.com/technical-drawings/

cavity_depth.rule: From the face to the bottom of the groove in the floor: 5.153 [0.203 in] on the drawing
cavity_depth.source: MakerBeam B.V., "overview specifications MB, MBXL, OB with pictures" (20161130), in MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawings folder, https://www.makerbeam.com/technical-drawings/

floor_width.rule: Width of the groove the floor slants down to: 1.65 [0.065 in] on the drawing
floor_width.source: MakerBeam B.V., "overview specifications MB, MBXL, OB with pictures" (20161130), in MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawings folder, https://www.makerbeam.com/technical-drawings/

flank_angle.rule: The slant of the floor, from the pocket's walls (straight to 3.70 from the face, on the drawing) down to the groove: 35 degrees from the face's plane, worked out from 3.70, 5.153, 5.80 and 1.65
flank_angle.source: MakerBeam B.V., "overview specifications MB, MBXL, OB with pictures" (20161130), in MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawings folder, https://www.makerbeam.com/technical-drawings/

nut_family.rule: It takes a plain M3 nut (DIN 934), or the head of an M3 hex screw: "designed to capture a regular DIN934 M3 nut"
nut_family.source: OpenBeam USA, "About" page as the Internet Archive saved it on 2017-07-16, http://www.openbeamusa.com/about/
